messages:
incident-bot: Pager: elevated 5xx rate observed for gateway-prod-us-east-1. 5xx = 13.7% over last 90s, spike on /v1/generate. Paging oncall @maria :rotating_light:

maria (oncall): on it. looking at dashboards now. any customer-facing alerts?

jordan (support): got a couple of customer reports, small set of API clients seeing 502/504. Repro steps attached by customer (curl).

lisa (sre): trending: upstream egress retries jumped at 13:46, connection resets from upstream pool. sending kvlog sample shortly.

kevin (runtime): hypothesis: retry amplification + reduced upstream headroom. saw queue length go from 20->250 for gateway worker group.

sanjay (platform): adding more gateway pods now (scale +2), will also open a temporary route fallback to next tier (low-capacity).

maria (oncall): pls paste a correlation id from a failing request so we can trace. also share kvlog tail.

kevin (runtime): here are two correlation ids from the error batch:
```
corr_id=7f8c3a9b-2d4b-4a1e-9f6a-3b2d1c0f4a55
corr_id=7f8c3a9b-2d4b-4a1e-9f6a-3b2d1c0f4a56
```

lisa (sre): kvlog snippet for corr_id=7f8c3a9b-2d4b-4a1e-9f6a-3b2d1c0f4a55:
```
[13:46:12] gateway-worker-12 - recv req /v1/generate size=1.2KB
[13:46:12] gateway-worker-12 - forward to upstream=runtime-prod-1 attempt=1
[13:46:13] runtime-prod-1 - ERR connection_reset
[13:46:13] gateway-worker-12 - retrying attempt=2
[13:46:13] gateway-worker-12 - forward to upstream=runtime-prod-2 attempt=2
[13:46:14] runtime-prod-2 - ERR backend_timeout
[13:46:14] gateway-worker-12 - respond 502
```

kevin (runtime): runtime logs show increased GC pauses around same time on runtime-prod-1; might have reduced concurrency. pairing with retry storm could amplify 5xx.

maria (oncall): immediate mitigations: 1) disable retries from gateway to runtime for 60s 2) open fallback route to cached-model 3) scale runtime pool +2. Can someone run 1) and 2) now?

sanjay (platform): disabling inter-service retries (gateway->runtime) via feature flag now (`gateway.retry.enabled=false`). rolling out in us-east.

ops-runbook-bot: Runbook step executed: "disable-upstream-retries" by sanjay at 13:48:05. Next step: monitor 5xx rate for 2 minutes.

lisa (sre): fallback route enabled to cached-model-prod for /v1/generate in us-east. traffic split 80/20 -> cached-model.

jordan (support): customer-impact summary for incident channel: ~12% of requests saw 5xx, duration ~13:46-13:52, major customers affected: two enterprise teams. raising severity to S2.

maria (oncall): building quick timeline below, add anything I miss:
T+0 13:45:50 alert fired - 5xx > 10%
T+1 13:46:10 upstream retries spike noticed
T+2 13:46:30 GC pause on runtime-prod-1 observed
T+3 13:47:00 platform scales gateway +2 and disables retries
T+4 13:47:30 fallback route enabled to cached-model
T+7 13:52:00 5xx rate back to baseline (~0.8%)

kevin (runtime): agree. preliminary hypothesis: runtime instance GC pause reduced throughput -> gateway retried requests -> amplified load on other upstreams -> backend timeouts (502). Need deeper trace to confirm.

sanjay (platform): saving kvlog bundle and traces under s3://incidents/2755554321/kvl-bundle.tar.gz. link: https://s3.company/2755554321/kvl-bundle.tar.gz

lisa (sre): next actions: 1) correlate spans for corr_id above 2) check runtime heap/GC logs 3) verify retry config around jitter/backoff 4) follow-up RCA doc. I'll take 1&2.

maria (oncall): thanks all, I'm handing off to kevin for deep dive. kevin you own post-incident RCA and timeline updates. I'll follow up with customers.

kevin (runtime): taking it. will post preliminary RCA in incidents channel by EOD. if anything spikes again re-pager me. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: Incident update: severity S2. Current 5xx rate: 0.9%. mitigations applied: retries_disabled, fallback_route, scale_out.
